proposals.before: Yelu Longyun was born Han Dezang, son of Kuangsi, the Southwestern Frontier Pacification Commissioner.
proposals.after: Yelu Longyun was born Han Derang, son of Kuangsi, the Southwestern Frontier Pacification Commissioner.
proposals.reason: 德讓 is Derang, not Dezang; the given name is consistently mistranscribed.

proposals.before: Yelu Longyun, originally surnamed Han, named Dezang, was the son of the Southwestern Frontier Pacification Commissioner Kuangsi.
proposals.after: Yelu Longyun, originally surnamed Han, named Derang, was the son of the Southwestern Frontier Pacification Commissioner Kuangsi.
proposals.reason: 德讓 is Derang, not Dezang.

proposals.before: He fell out with Han Dezang over a matter of policy. Dezang, enraged, seized a guard's weapon and struck him on the head, killing him outright.
proposals.after: He fell out with Han Derang over a matter of policy. Derang, enraged, seized a guard's weapon and struck him on the head, killing him outright.
proposals.reason: 德讓 is Derang, not Dezang.

proposals.before: Appraisal: During Tonghe, Dezang held the powers of both general and minister. In defeating enemies, advancing worthy men, and sustaining the state, his achievements were abundant indeed.
proposals.after: Appraisal: During Tonghe, Derang held the powers of both general and minister. In defeating enemies, advancing worthy men, and sustaining the state, his achievements were abundant indeed.
proposals.reason: 德讓 is Derang, not Dezang.

proposals.before: As the empress's uterine younger brother, his favor at court grew day by day.
proposals.after: As the empress's younger brother, his favor at court grew day by day.
proposals.reason: 外弟 here means the empress's younger brother; 'uterine' is unsupported.

proposals.before: At the end of Qianheng, when his father's mourning period ended he was forcibly recalled to office and served provisionally as Southwestern Pacification Commissioner.
proposals.after: At the end of Qianheng, when he was in mourning for his father he was forcibly recalled to office and served provisionally as Southwestern Pacification Commissioner.
proposals.reason: 丁父喪 means he entered/was in mourning, not that mourning had ended.

proposals.before: When Emperor Jingzong fell gravely ill, he and Yelu Xiezhen together received the dying command: they enthroned the Prince of Liang, made the empress dowager, and she assumed regency.
proposals.after: When Emperor Jingzong fell gravely ill, he and Yelu Xiezhen together received the dying command: they enthroned the Prince of Liang as emperor, made the empress empress dowager, and she assumed regency.
proposals.reason: 皇后為皇太后 means the empress was made empress dowager; the idiomatic omits that she had been empress.

decisions.reason: 名德讓 gives the personal name Derang (讓 ràng), not Dezang; the idiomatic mistranscription is a real naming error and Han Derang restores it.
名德讓 is Derang; the literal named Dezang misreads 讓 and the proposed Derang matches the Chinese.
與韓德讓…德讓怒 names Han Derang twice; replacing Dezang with Derang corrects the same 讓/ràng misreading without changing the clash or killing.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 與韓德讓以事相忤，德讓怒

decisions.reason: 論曰：德讓在統和間 begins the appraisal with Derang; Dezang is the same false reading of 讓 and Derang is the accurate replacement.
以皇后外弟 marks him as the empress's younger brother (natal/affine 外弟); uterine (同母) is not in the Chinese, so dropping that invented qualifier is correct.
丁父喪 means he was in mourning for his father; 強起復職 is forced recall from mourning. The literal's 'mourning period ended' reverses the Chinese, and the proposed wording matches it.

decisions.after: When Emperor Jingzong fell gravely ill, he and Yelu Xiezhen together received the dying command: they enthroned the Prince of Liang as emperor, made the empress the empress dowager, and she assumed regency.
decisions.reason: 立梁王為帝，皇后為皇太后 requires both elevating the Prince of Liang as emperor and turning the empress into empress dowager. The original omits that transition; the proposal's 'made the empress empress dowager' is right in sense but awkward, so the article is restored.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 立梁王為帝，皇后為皇太后，稱制

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0001 shows the English given-name Dezang was produced only by misreading 德讓; Derang matches zh/pinyin while id, subject, predicate, and evidence stay the same.
Accepted r0001 likewise corrects the full personal-name English Han Dezang to Han Derang for 韓德讓; the underlying name fact remains.
